_comment: Pre-publish brand-check token list. Read by scripts/check-forbidden-tokens.mjs (called from scripts/build-npm.sh). Tokens listed here must not appear in tracked source. Paths in allowPaths are git pathspecs (literal or glob) where tokens are intentionally allowed (release notes, the brand-check config itself, historical port plans, etc). The CI brand-check job in .github/workflows/pr.yml is the broader gate with 9 nuanced guards; this list is the narrower, last-line-of-defense pre-publish check for fully-renamed tokens that should never reappear in shipping source.
_tokens_comment: User-visible brand strings include their leading quote (" or `) so we match the actual code literal ("Start Paperclip" / `Paperclip dashboard`) rather than free-form prose (e.g. 'restart Paperclip and re-run' in shell scripts), mirroring the pattern used in the .github/workflows/pr.yml brand-check guards 4 and 8.
